svg.title: Role-Based Dashboards and Shared Navigation — code design
svg.desc: Admin: organization overview; Coach: all meets; Athlete: own nominated meets. SUNNY: login / dashboard route -> session role -> role summary + own notifications -> cards / meets / outstanding actions -> existing authorized feature. Desktop top nav or mobile hamburger uses the same permissions. ADMIN / COACH: Admin receives organization statistics and Admin quick actions; Coach monitors all meets and can assign events, record results, edit programs and review availability without Admin-only actions. ATHLETE: nominated meets + own availability + next published scheduled event. No Pending responses -> All Caught Up; no nominations/schedule -> clear empty state; My Profile and notifications remain accessible. EMPTY / FAILURE: no upcoming meets, no staff actions or no recent notifications -> section-specific empty state. Failed section -> unavailable message + retry; other accessible sections stay usable. AUTHORIZATION: wrong-role feature request -> server denies; unrelated athlete records -> denied using linked athlete identity. Role navigation and responsive layouts preserve the same access rules on every device.
